dct_description_sm: Abstract: Line features derived from the King County, Washington street network coverage (kcsn) with a denormalized attribute table. Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties.
Purpose: Designed to support geocoding and street labeling with the street name table joined to the feature attribute table.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: Plots/maps displaying streets from this coverage must include a disclaimer indicating that the source of the data is from maps produced by Kroll. This disclaimer must read as follows: THIS DOCUMENT INCLUDES DATA COPYRIGHTED BY THE KROLL MAP COMPANY AND IS BEING USED WITH THEIR PERMISSION. USE IS RESTRICTED. For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
